# a comment. \n, \t, and \\ are the only escapes. An empty value is a field
# Every suite builds the signer endpoint names, with key and prefix, and
# signs input. A record with signed asserts that the result equals it. A
# record with error asserts that the signer refuses the input. A record with
# message asserts that the message the signer hashed equals it, so a failure
# names the step that went wrong. query is the canonical query, and only the
# An empty prefix means the signer's default.
# dims-sign --fixture writes every computed field. The keys, the client id,
# and the expiry are the ones in test/conf/dims-test.conf, so the HTTP suite
# sends each signed URL as it is.
